item.timex_rebirth.production_module.des: Each level placed in a module slot increases heat generator output by 10% (max 5 levels)

item.timex_rebirth.wasteland_stew.desc: A hot stew of baked turnip and cooked meat. Eating it drives off the cold (raises core temperature).
item.timex_rebirth.wasteland_broth.desc: A hearty broth simmered from bones and turnip. Warming and thirst-quenching.
item.timex_rebirth.canned_food.desc: Long-lasting canned rations sealed in iron. Restores sanity when eaten, and returns an empty can.
item.timex_rebirth.empty_can.desc: An emptied tin can. Smelt it in a furnace to reclaim 1 iron ingot.
item.timex_rebirth.dried_meat.desc: Smoke-dried meat strips. Long shelf life, perfect for expeditions.
item.timex_rebirth.instant_noodles.desc: Long-lasting noodles packed in a paper bowl. Returns the paper bowl when eaten.
item.timex_rebirth.paper_bowl.desc: A disposable bowl pressed from cardboard. Can be recycled back to pulp via heated mixing.
item.timex_rebirth.herbal_tea.desc: Brewed from herbs and clean water in a Create heated mixer into herbal tea fluid, then bottled with a glass bottle. Soothes the mind, restores sanity and warms you up; drinkable even at full hunger.
item.timex_rebirth.anti_freeze.desc: Right-click dirt / coarse dirt / grass block to convert it into anti-freeze dirt, right-click farmland for anti-freeze farmland (never freezes in cold weather), and right-click permafrost to thaw it. Each use costs 1 durability.
item.timex_rebirth.anti_freeze_gel.desc: A low-temperature gel; combine with iron plates to craft anti-freeze.
block.timex_rebirth.fireproof_casing.des: A heat-resistant building block, made by using a fireproof brick on cobbled deepslate.
item.timex_rebirth.fireproof_brick.desc: A fire-resistant brick; use it on cobbled deepslate to craft fireproof casing.
item.timex_rebirth.heat_alloy_ingot.desc: A heat-resistant metal fused from iron, copper and blaze powder in a heated mixer; the core material of heating equipment.
item.timex_rebirth.insulated_glass.desc: Insulating glass made from glass, snow and wool; keeps heat in heat-source equipment.
item.timex_rebirth.rye.desc: A cold-hardy winter crop that can be milled into rye flour.
item.timex_rebirth.rye_straw.desc: The straw of rye; usable as fuel and for making paper.

advancement.timex_rebirth.category_scrap: Things left behind by the old world — make good use of them
advancement.timex_rebirth.category_defen: The world is dangerous; defend against every kind of monster
advancement.timex_rebirth.drying_witness: Witness a wet item being dried
advancement.timex_rebirth.cold_hardy_cro: Obtain a cold-hardy crop (rye or turnip)
advancement.timex_rebirth.anti_freeze_pr: Use anti-freeze to make soil freeze-proof
advancement.timex_rebirth.food_maker.des: Make canned food or instant noodles
advancement.timex_rebirth.rotten_food_ea: Eat rotten leftovers or their bowl versions
advancement.timex_rebirth.hot_spring.des: Bathe in heat flux and feel its warmth
advancement.timex_rebirth.rocket_launche: Get an explosive arrow to deal with those nasty monsters
research.timex_rebirth.node.tools_mainte: Learn to build and use an anvil: repair item durability, combine enchantments and rename items at the anvil - a must for long-term survival.
research.timex_rebirth.node.alchemy_basi: Learn to build and use a brewing stand: brew potions from water, blaze powder and ingredients, and craft splash/lingering variants for combat and wilderness survival.
research.timex_rebirth.node.enchanting_k: Learn to build and use an enchantment table: spend lapis lazuli to enchant weapons, tools and armor with powerful enchantments to face the wasteland.
Learn to craft basic tools such as axes, pickaxes, shovels and hoes, plus Farmers' Delight knives - the foundation of wasteland survival and resource gathering.
research.timex_rebirth.node.sword_crafti: Learn to forge swords, bows, crossbows and shields, mastering melee and ranged weapon crafting to protect yourself in the wasteland.
research.timex_rebirth.node.armor_forgin: Learn to forge leather, iron, golden and diamond armor, creating full armor sets to withstand wasteland threats.
research.timex_rebirth.node.gun_assembly: Learn to use the Gun Workbench: assemble firearms and ammunition there, mastering the most formidable gunpowder technology in the wasteland.
research.timex_rebirth.node.crop_cultiva: Learn to cultivate winter crops: unlocks rye and turnip seed usage (you cannot plant them before researching this). Harvested rye grains can be milled into rye flour with Create's millstone or crushing wheels.
research.timex_rebirth.node.baking.desc: Unlocks baking-related recipes: mix rye flour with water into dough using a Create mechanical mixer, then bake the dough into cold-proof rye bread in a furnace, smoker or campfire.
Unlocks papermaking recipes: make paper from rye straw, sugar cane or Farmer's Delight tree bark by heating and mixing them with water.
research.timex_rebirth.node.soup_cooking: Unlocks soup recipes: stew wasteland stew from baked turnip and cooked meat, and simmer wasteland broth from bones and turnips in a Farmers' Delight cooking pot to fend off the cold.
research.timex_rebirth.node.food_process: Unlocks food processing recipes: seal cooked meat in iron cans for long-lasting canned food, smoke dried meat strips, and cook raw pasta with meat into long-lasting instant noodles in a cardboard cup.
research.timex_rebirth.node.food_plating: Unlocks drink recipes: brew herbal tea fluid from herbs and clean water in a Create heated mixer, then bottle it with a glass bottle to restore thirst and sanity.
research.timex_rebirth.node.heat_base.de: Unlocks the heating base recipe and placement: it is the foundation of the heat supply station - the heat generator must be placed on top of a heating base to work.
research.timex_rebirth.node.heat_core.de: Unlocks the heat generator recipe and teaches you to build and use a heat supply station: place the generator on a heating base, feed it fuel to produce heat flux for adapters, module slots and more.
research.timex_rebirth.node.heat_parts.d: Unlocks recipes for the fuel receiver, heat adapter, module slot and heat receiver - learn how to assemble and link the whole heat supply station.
research.timex_rebirth.node.heat_modules: Unlocks the energy-save and production module recipes: place them in a module slot - energy-save cuts fuel use 10% per level, production boosts heat output 10% per level (5 levels max each).
research.timex_rebirth.node.basecore_cor: Learn how to build and interact with the base core: without this research you cannot interact with a placed base core (right-click to open its interface).
research.timex_rebirth.node.module_craft: Unlocks module manufacturing for the base core and defense turret: buy and install modules with parts in the base core / defense turret upgrade menu.
research.timex_rebirth.node.basecore_def: Unlocks placement of the defense turret and secure chest: set up turrets to guard your base and build secure chests to store valuables.
research.timex_rebirth.node.basecore_att: Unlocks crafting and use of the electromagnetic pulse bomb, disguise devices and interference device: paralyze enemy facilities with EMP bombs, sneak in with disguise devices (basic/advanced/extreme), and jam enemy base signals and loot supplies with the interference device.
research.timex_rebirth.node.create_logis: Unlocks placement of belts, chutes, funnels, tunnels and portable storage interfaces - learn to build and use a system for moving, sorting and storing items.
research.timex_rebirth.node.create_andes: Unlocks placement of water wheels, encased fans, millstones, presses, pistons, drills, saws, deployers and mechanical mixers - learn to build a power network: drive machines with a water wheel, mill flour with a millstone, press and saw materials.
research.timex_rebirth.node.create_brass: Unlocks placement of mechanical crafters, mechanical arms, sequenced gearshifts and clockwork bearings - learn to build an automated production line: crafters assemble automatically, arms move items, gearshifts sequence steps.
research.timex_rebirth.node.create_train: Unlocks placement of tracks, stations, signals, train controls and train doors - learn to build a railway: lay track between bases, build stations and signalling, and drive trains to haul bulk cargo.

item.timex_rebirth.explosive_arrow.desc: An arrow that explodes on hitting a block or creature - about the power of a small TNT.
item.timex_rebirth.watermelon_rind.desc: Leftover watermelon rind. Compostable, and can be crafted back into melon seeds.
item.timex_rebirth.rotten_meal_bowl.desc: A bowl of moldy leftover meal. Compostable (the bowl is returned after composting), or you can grit your teeth and eat it - eating it will likely leave you hungry and nauseated.
item.timex_rebirth.rotten_meat_bowl.desc: A bowl of rotten, foul-smelling meat. Compostable (the bowl is returned after composting), or you can grit your teeth and eat it - eating it will likely leave you hungry and nauseated.
item.timex_rebirth.damaged_gpu.desc: A scrapped GPU core - you can still see its former glory.
item.timex_rebirth.damaged_ram.desc: A broken RAM stick with oxidized contacts.
item.timex_rebirth.iron_debris.desc: Common rusty iron debris of the wasteland.
item.timex_rebirth.rusty_copper_sheet.de: A copper scrap covered in verdigris; still recyclable.
A bent sheet of aluminum pulled from the ruins.
item.timex_rebirth.burnt_chip.desc: An overloaded, scorched chip reeking of burnt circuitry.
item.timex_rebirth.damaged_wire.desc: A damaged protective wire with exposed strands - mind the voltage.
item.timex_rebirth.damaged_filter.desc: A torn filter that can no longer keep out wasteland dust.
item.timex_rebirth.damaged_circuit_board: A corroded circuit board with broken traces.
item.timex_rebirth.broken_screw.desc: A snapped screw with worn threads.
item.timex_rebirth.rusty_spring.desc: A rusted, seized spring that has long lost its bounce.
item.timex_rebirth.shattered_screen.desc: A cracked display screen, spiderwebbed with fractures.
item.timex_rebirth.damaged_motor.desc: A broken motor with scorched windings.
item.timex_rebirth.burnt_cable.desc: A burned cable with melted insulation.
